text:
maria: Heads up — noticed ~40 leads in the last 2 hrs that are hitting 'unowned' because enrichment is returning null for account_id. SLA dashboard shows first-touch SLA breaches. :/

josh: Ugh. Any pattern on source or form? landing page?

maria: Mostly from webinar signup and product trial form. Source=webinar_apr22 or trial-embed. HubSpot workflow for 'assign owner' expects company.domain OR account_id. When enrichment returns null we drop into unowned.

eli: I saw the same in logs — the enrichment job (hs->clearbit) timeouted for a subset when company domain was personal emails (gmail/yahoo). The workflow uses property check: "company.domain IS known" before assign. So fallback never triggers.

ana: @ana (cc) -> propose three quick fixes: 1) Add a fallback owner to the HS workflow (assign to SDR-overflow) 2) Add a task automation to triage unowned leads every 30m 3) Backfill missed leads from last 24h via export/import. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

ana: short version: fast mitigation + durable fix.

josh: +1 to fallback owner. We should only route overflow to SDR-overflow team for 1 business hour, then escalate to SDR-manager if still unassigned. Keeps SLA window short.

eli: Agreed. Also recommend adding a lightweight enrichment retry in our integration lambda — if clearbit returns null, retry x2 with 2s backoff before marking as failed. That will cut down intermittent timeouts.

maria: I'll patch the workflow tonight. Draft of workflow change:

--- HubSpot workflow snippet ---
Trigger: Contact created OR Company updated
If: company.domain is known -> Assign to rep via round-robin
Else: Set contact property "temporary_owner_team" = "SDR-overflow"
Action: Assign owner = lookup_team_member(temporary_owner_team) // round-robin assignment using team pool
Delay: 1 hour -> If owner still blank -> create task "Escalate to SDR manager" and notify #sales-escalations
--- end snippet ---

eli: Nice. For the round-robin we still need to ensure our API call uses sticky rotation: last_assigned index persisted in Vault. See internal module: salesops/robin-service.

ana: Can you include a small curl we can use to backfill? For reviewers.

maria: backfill example: 
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/marketing/backfill-leads" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"since":"2026-04-21T00:00:00Z","filters":[{"property":"hs_lead_status","op":"eq","value":"unowned"}] }'

josh: FYI I'll also flip the HubSpot workflow test to run on a small sample before 11pm PST. If all green, rollout to prod.

salesops-bot: Alert created: #SRD-assign-fallback - runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inbound-routing - owner: maria - ETA: 45m

hubspot-bot: HubSpot workflow "Assign owner v2" scheduled for 2026-04-22T02:00:00Z (dry-run)

maria: Thanks all — action items: 1) maria apply workflow fallback (tonight) 2) eli add retry to enrichment lambda (tomorrow) 3) josh validate round-robin sticky state + monitor (today) 4) ana coordinate backfill and notify SDR manager if >50 leads. I'll post a short post-mortem in #marketing after run. :eyes:

eli: I'll instrument an extra metric for enrichment retry success and post to SLO dashboard.

josh: I'll watch SLA dashboard and slack-alerts. Ping me if you see spike.

maria: Closing thread when fallback is live. Thanks :rocket:
